title: Patching the Blind Spots: Reversible LLM Rule Overlay for Frozen Fraud Detectors
abstract: arXiv:2611.08714v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In industrial tabular fraud classification, gradient-boosted trees remain state-of-the-art, but even a well-trained model has blind spots, and retraining the deployed model is not always safe. We propose a framework that patches such a model without modifying it: LLMs propose rules anchored on features the model underweights by SHAP, and the resulting noisy pool is screened for empirical support and calibrated into an additive, reversible log-lift overlay that runs at the production cut-off. Single-LLM benefit is high-variance and inverts between datasets, so we pool three diverse backbones by equal-weight logit averaging, trading peak gain for a bounded worst case. On a real-world e-commerce fraud detector trained on selection-biased data, continued training regresses even when carefully tuned, whereas the overlay gains on average +2.26% recall at equal precision ($\Delta$R@P) and +1.60% precision at equal recall ($\Delta$P@R) over pr

translated_title: 修补盲点：面向冻结欺诈检测器的可逆LLM规则叠加层
translated_abstract: 在工业表格型欺诈分类任务中，梯度提升树仍然是最先进的方法，但即使是训练良好的模型也存在盲点，而对已部署模型进行重新训练并不总是安全的。我们提出了一个无需修改模型即可对其进行修补的框架：LLM基于SHAP识别出的模型低估特征提出规则，随后对由此产生的含噪规则池进行实证支持筛选，并将其校准为一个可加的、可逆的对数提升叠加层，在生产截止阈值处运行。单个LLM带来的收益方差很高，且在不同数据集之间会出现反转，因此我们通过对三个不同的骨干模型进行等权logit平均来汇聚其结果，以牺牲峰值收益来换取有界的最坏情况表现。在一个基于选择性偏差数据训练的真实电商欺诈检测器上，即使经过精心调优，持续训练仍会导致性能退化，而该叠加层在同等精确率下平均提升召回率2.26%（ΔR@P），在同等召回率下平均提升精确率1.60%（ΔP@R）。
tldr: 提出一个可逆的LLM规则叠加框架，在不修改冻结欺诈检测模型的前提下，利用SHAP定位模型盲点并由LLM生成、筛选、校准规则，通过多模型logit平均池化，在真实电商欺诈检测中于同等精确率下平均提升召回率2.26%。
en_tdlr: A reversible LLM rule overlay framework patches frozen fraud detectors without modifying them, using SHAP to identify blind spots and pooling three LLM backbones via logit averaging, achieving +2.26% recall at equal precision on a real-world e-commerce fraud detector.
